body:
OBSERVED, confirmed independently (Opus).

`useBulkActions().remove` fans out per-book deletes through
`settle = Promise.allSettled` (`frontend/src/lib/queries.ts:646,666-674`).
`Promise.allSettled` NEVER rejects, so the mutation's `onSuccess` runs even when every
request failed. `onSuccess` then evicts every requested id from cache unconditionally
(`ids.forEach(removeBookFromCache)`), and `BulkBar.tsx:77-81` announces
"{n} book(s) deleted." using the ORIGINAL selection count.

So a bulk delete where some or all books failed to delete tells the user they were all
deleted and removes them from view. Reloading brings them back.

This is independent of F-c6b236: fixing the API's false 204 does not fix this, because
`allSettled` would still resolve on genuine rejections.

Fix shape: inspect settlement status per item; evict only confirmed deletions; report
truthful succeeded/failed counts. Note the same `settle()` helper backs markRead and
addToShelf, so audit those for the same false-success shape (compare F-a24ccb, which
found the equivalent bug in bulk metadata edits — this is the same defect class
recurring, which suggests fixing the helper rather than each caller).
title: Bulk delete announces every selected book deleted even when requests failed
